'''Thall Joben's mother''' lived with her [[Thall Joben's father|partner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]]. A champion [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] racer, her partner was almost [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a crash two days before the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of their [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall]]. When he later refused to let Thall become a racer himself, Thall stowed aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] bound for the planet [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. Only upon his father's death, at some point prior to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], did Thall return to Beheboth. At the funeral, Thall's mother told him about his father's former career. She died herself a few months later.
